c6.refugee.speaker: Refugee
c6.refugee.text: The tower gate opened… we don't dare go up. Are you… that rabbit?

c6.scroll_pile.speaker: Scroll
c6.scroll_pile.text: «The weakest may reach the summit. The line unwritten: should the heart covet strength, the flame arrives first.»

c6.tower_gate.speaker: Narration
c6.tower_gate.text: The tower gate stands open. First time in a thousand years. The Black Flame breathes in the gap.

c0.shrine_stub.speaker: Shrine
c0.shrine_stub.text: The incense ash is cold. Did the gods flee too — or did the people leave first?

c0.field_west.speaker: Narration
c0.field_west.text: Night has bitten through the field paths and the fences. The world is bigger than the village — and you've only just taken the first step.

c0.leave_without_sword.speaker: System
c0.leave_without_sword.text: Empty-handed. At the very least… pick up that sword.

c0.road_east.speaker: Narration
c0.road_east.text: The long road runs east. Cuiling is larger than the map draws it.

c1.flag_paw.speaker: System
c1.flag_paw.text: A crooked rabbit paw in charcoal on the banner. «Someone drew a rabbit. The ears are a bit off; the courage isn't.»

c1.flag_grey.speaker: System
c1.flag_grey.text: The grey banner hangs limp. Everyone in the city is waiting on an impossible miracle.

c1.outer_ward.speaker: Narration
c1.outer_ward.text: The outer ward is wider than you pictured. The knights' domain was Cuiling's backbone once — now it's stone and wind.

c1.save_stone.speaker: System
c1.save_stone.text: Progress written to the save stone. Your wounds have settled too. {extra}

c1.sprout_after_leo.speaker: Sprout
c1.sprout_after_leo.text: I drew the rabbit on the banner! The ears came out crooked, but the courage is right!

c1.sprout_after_leo.speaker: Sprout
c1.sprout_after_leo.text: I practise with a wooden sword every day. When I grow up I'll guard the gate! Fierce like Greybeard — but also not fierce, like you.

c1.sprout_thanks.speaker: Sprout
c1.sprout_thanks.text: The wooden sword swings great! Thank you! So… is the lion big? Are you really going?

c1.sprout_wish.speaker: Sprout
c1.sprout_wish.text: Ding could make one, I think it's about twenty gold. Or give me thirty and I'll go buy it myself!

c1.sprout_wish.speaker: Sprout
c1.sprout_wish.text: I'm not being greedy! I want to practise and show everyone!

c1.wild_need_forge.speaker: System
c1.wild_need_forge.text: The rusty sword's edge has rolled. Go find Ding first.

c1.burnt_field.speaker: Narration
c1.burnt_field.text: Burnt wheat field. There's a raw sweetness of Black Flame in the wind. You grip the Meager Edge tighter.

c1.tower_empty.speaker: System
c1.tower_empty.text: The watchtower is empty. Only wind.

c1.wild_shrine.speaker: Shrine
c1.wild_shrine.text: «What's guarded is not the gate. It's the little light behind it.»

c1.leo_gate_cleared.speaker: System
c1.leo_gate_cleared.text: The Sacred Lion has woken. The sanctum has gone quiet. The misty road to the southeast is open.

c1.leo_win.speaker: Leo
c1.leo_win.text: So this is it… a true knight is the courage not to retreat, however small you are.

c1.leo_win.speaker: Leo
c1.leo_win.text: Go, rabbit — the fortress gate opens for you.

c1.leo_win.speaker: Leo
c1.leo_win.text: The Black Flame doesn't want your life. It wants your wanting. Don't feed it.

c1.leo_win.speaker: System
c1.leo_win.text: 80 gold, 4 stardust, +10 max health. Gold runs through your fur. Rage Thunder and Counterstrike wake with it.

c2.arrive.speaker: Veilfog
c2.arrive.text: In the mist, true and false are the same colour. Lend me your eyes.

c2.arrive.speaker: Veilfog
c2.arrive.text: Stay the night first. Those who walk at night break inside before anything else.

c2.arrive.speaker: System
c2.arrive.text: Something seems to be waiting for you… by the inn's campfire.

c2.lantern.speaker: Narration
c2.lantern.text: The mist lantern lights three paces. Past that, you go by your own eyes.

c2.well_fog.speaker: Narration
c2.well_fog.text: There's no water in the well — only thicker mist. They say if you fall in, you dream of yourself.

c2.laundry.speaker: Narration
c2.laundry.text: The clothes are still wet and there's nobody around. Does the mist hang the laundry for people?

c2.cat_shadow.speaker: Thought
c2.cat_shadow.text: A real cat, or a cry the mist learned?

c2.shrine.speaker: Mist Shrine
c2.shrine.text: «The true, one instant. The false, a thousand layers.»

c2.shrine.speaker: Thought
c2.shrine.text: One instant is enough. I only want that instant.

c2.train_need_letter.speaker: System
c2.train_need_letter.text: Your mind is unsettled. Head back to the inn first.

c2.train_tip.speaker: Veilfog
c2.train_tip.text: Shadows lie. The real body flares once. Remember that once.

c2.train_tip.speaker: System
c2.train_tip.text: You can only land a hit in the instant the real body flares white. Switch targets with Tab or 1/2/3.

c2.letter_reread.speaker: System
c2.letter_reread.text: The letter is still in your journal.

c2.letter_reread.speaker: Journal
c2.letter_reread.text: «I'm still here. Not because of the prophecy — because you haven't come back yet.» — Wheatear

c2.fog_need_letter.speaker: Veilfog
c2.fog_need_letter.text: There's still a letter owed inside you. Go back to the inn.

c2.fog_cleared.speaker: System
c2.fog_cleared.text: The mirror hall is still. You can return to the village or carry on.

c2.fog_win.speaker: White Fog
c2.fog_win.text: You saw through it… how dull.

c2.fog_win.speaker: White Fog
c2.fog_win.text: The mist is gone, the road's right in front of you — go on.

c2.fog_win.speaker: System
c2.fog_win.text: 70 gold, 4 stardust, +8 max health. Your coat takes the colour of mist. A bell rings from the mountain…

c3.soft_warn.speaker: System
c3.soft_warn.text: You can climb without having seen through White Fog — Abo won't go easy on you for it. Power {power}.

c3.soft_warn.speaker: System
c3.soft_warn.text: If it's not enough, forge and read stars in the city, or train at the yard or the Starpath hunting grounds.

c3.arrive.speaker: Acha
c3.arrive.text: A guest out of the mist? The master's in the trial hall. He doesn't strike first. He asks first.

c3.arrive.speaker: System
c3.arrive.text: The dojo is open to explore. Challenge Abo in the trial hall.

c3.gate_bell.speaker: Narration
c3.gate_bell.text: The bell rings once. The valley hands the echo back: what do you fight for?

c3.dummy_done.speaker: System
c3.dummy_done.text: There's a fresh fist print on the wooden dummy. Yours.

c3.scroll_wall.speaker: Fist Manual
c3.scroll_wall.text: «Guard is broken by diligence, not by anger.»

c3.scroll_wall.speaker: Fist Manual
c3.scroll_wall.text: «Anger full, fist scattered. Fist scattered, guard broken.»

c3.stone_garden.speaker: Narration
c3.stone_garden.text: The stones are laid out in the shape of a fist. Someone moves one every day — until the mind is still.

c3.abo_cleared.speaker: System
c3.abo_cleared.text: The trial hall is empty. Abo sits on the threshold drinking tea.

c4.arrive.speaker: Windear
c4.arrive.text: If you want to meet Swiftshadow — learn to wait first. The beat where the wind stops, that's the real one.

c4.arrive.speaker: System
c4.arrive.text: The Ranger Forest is open. Swiftshadow's nest lies east.

c4.treehouse.speaker: Narration
c4.treehouse.text: The treehouses are linked by vine rope. A kite string is tangled on the railing, its end still trembling.

c4.treehouse.speaker: Child
c4.treehouse.text: (From far off) My kite… the wind took it!

c4.kite_freed.speaker: System
c4.kite_freed.text: The kite is back with the child. The string is wound up neatly.

c4.stream.speaker: Narration
c4.stream.text: The stream runs clear. Leaf shadows on the surface — no purple crack. A rare thing.

c4.owl_post.speaker: Thought
c4.owl_post.text: It's watching the wind, not me.

c4.arrow_path_done.speaker: System
c4.arrow_path_done.text: The arrow path is quiet. Now and then the wind still cuts across the grass tips.

c4.watch_tower.speaker: Inscription
c4.watch_tower.text: «Swiftshadow guards the wind. The wind guards those who walk the road.»

c4.watch_tower.speaker: Inscription
c4.watch_tower.text: «If the wind goes mad — wait until it remembers that it, too, once stopped for someone.»

c4.watch_tower.speaker: Thought
c4.watch_tower.text: Waiting… isn't weakness. It's seeing clearly.

c4.herb_looted.speaker: System
c4.herb_looted.text: The dew on the herb slope has already been gathered.

c4.falcon_cleared.speaker: System
c4.falcon_cleared.text: The nest is empty. Only wind, and a tuft of silver feathers.

c4.falcon_win.speaker: Swiftshadow
c4.falcon_win.text: You caught the wind… what an interesting creature.

c4.falcon_win.speaker: Swiftshadow
c4.falcon_win.text: Take the silver feather. Not a reward — a reminder: someone is willing to stop for you.

c4.falcon_win.speaker: Windear
c4.falcon_win.text: (In the distance) …Go. The coast is still roaring.

c4.falcon_win.speaker: System
c4.falcon_win.text: 85 gold, 4 stardust, +8 max health. Your coat turns the grey of wind.

c5.arrive.speaker: Tideroar
c5.arrive.text: Stonefist isn't swinging to smash you. He forgot where the strength was supposed to go.

c5.arrive.speaker: System
c5.arrive.text: The coast is open. Stonefist Cliff lies east.

c5.dock.speaker: Narration
c5.dock.text: The dock town is nearly empty. Nets dry on the racks, as if no one dares put out to sea.

c5.dock.speaker: System
c5.dock.text: Someone wrote on a board in charcoal: strength without direction is just surf on an empty shore.

c5.boat_wreck.speaker: Narration
c5.boat_wreck.text: Half a sack of salt still sits in the broken hull. The salt is dry — the waves didn't take it; the people left first.

c5.net_rack.speaker: Narration
c5.net_rack.text: The nets are crusted with salt crystals. As if someone wove the waves and forgot to bring them in.

c5.runestone.speaker: Runestone
c5.runestone.text: «Strength is for shelter, not for show.»

c5.forge_tip_done.speaker: Tideroar
c5.forge_tip_done.text: (Echo) The axe's intent lives in the edge, not in the throat.

c5.cliff_path.speaker: Narration
c5.cliff_path.text: Old and new rockfall marks cross on the cliff path. The ground still carries the scorch of safe circles that once lit up.

c5.cliff_path.speaker: System
c5.cliff_path.text: Before a rock falls, the ground lights up first. When you see it, press J to dodge.

c5.boar_cleared.speaker: System
c5.boar_cleared.text: It's quiet on the cliff. Only the waves, like applause.

c5.boar_win.speaker: Stonefist
c5.boar_win.text: Hahaha! The one still standing is you!

c5.boar_win.speaker: Stonefist
c5.boar_win.text: …Strength was for guarding the shore. Thank you for the reminder.

c5.boar_win.speaker: Tideroar
c5.boar_win.text: (Roaring with laughter) Good rabbit! Go to the tower!

c5.boar_win.speaker: System
c5.boar_win.text: 95 gold, 5 stardust, +10 max health. The tips of your fur burn a ring of fire colour.

c6.bell_not_rung.speaker: System
c6.bell_not_rung.text: The mountain bell hasn't rung. Go up to the dojo first.

c6.path_not_open.speaker: System
c6.path_not_open.text: The road isn't open yet. Finish the trial in front of you first.

c6.floor_shadow.speaker: Narration
c6.floor_shadow.text: The shadow gallery. Someone is whispering behind the walls.

c6.floor_shadow.speaker: Phantom Voice
c6.floor_shadow.text: Get strong and you can save everyone. Swallow the flame and the world will go quiet.

c6.floor_shadow.speaker: Thought
c6.floor_shadow.text: …No. That isn't quiet. That's going out.

c6.floor_shadow.speaker: System
c6.floor_shadow.text: You crossed the shadow gallery without drawing your sword.

c6.demon_win.speaker: Predecessor
c6.demon_win.text: Next time… don't walk my road.

c6.demon_win.speaker: Predecessor
c6.demon_win.text: The sword is yours again. Or — give it to the next one as light as we were.

c6.demon_win.speaker: System
c6.demon_win.text: 150 gold, 8 stardust. Five threads of starlight rise and settle on your fur.

post.rift_not_open.speaker: System
post.rift_not_open.text: The rift hasn't overflowed yet. Finish the trial at the summit first.

post.rift_win.speaker: System
post.rift_win.text: «{mode}» has gone quiet for now. Wins: {wins}. {extra}
